title: Plan snow ops dispatch app
prompt: I want to build a snow ops dispatch applicaiton for madison snow removal.

steps.code: pwd && rg --files . || find . -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort

cat > docs/snow-ops-app-plan.md <<'EOF'
# Madison Snow Removal Dispatch App

## Core roles
- Dispatcher
- Driver
- Admin

## Core features
- Job intake and priority queue
- Route assignment and reassignment
- Live job status tracking
- Driver check-in and notes
- Property list with service history
- Storm event dashboard
- Notifications for overdue jobs

## Initial data model
- customers
- properties
- service_requests
- storm_events
- routes
- assignments
- drivers
- vehicles
- status_updates

## Initial build phases
1. Scaffold app
2. Define schema
3. Build dispatch dashboard
4. Build driver workflow
5. Add auth and permissions
6. Add tests and seed data
EOF

steps.description: Scaffold application if repo is empty
steps.code: if [ -z "$(rg --files . 2>/dev/null)" ]; then mkdir -p app src docs tests; fi

cat > docs/product-requirements.json <<'EOF'
{
  "appName": "Madison Snow Removal Dispatch",
  "users": ["dispatcher", "driver", "admin"],
  "features": [
    "dispatch board",
    "route management",
    "job status updates",
    "customer/property records",
    "storm event tracking",
    "notifications"
  ],
  "entities": [
    "drivers",
    "vehicles",
    "properties",
    "service_requests",
    "assignments",
    "routes",
    "storm_events"
  ]
}
EOF

steps.description: Search for existing app stack files

steps.code:
cat > docs/implementation-todo.md <<'EOF'
- Choose stack and scaffold frontend/backend
- Add authentication and roles
- Create database schema and migrations
- Build dispatcher dashboard
- Build driver mobile-friendly views
- Add route assignment workflow
- Add status update endpoints
- Seed sample Madison-area jobs and drivers
- Add end-to-end smoke tests
EOF
test -f docs/snow-ops-app-plan.md && test -f docs/product-requirements.json && test -f docs/implementation-todo.md
